ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_AccidentallyVegan_: Survive 20 days with all drifters eating only Seaweed Salads.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_AllGasNoBrakes_Des: Have 50 or more buildings upgraded with Gas Bags.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_BiggerIsBetter_Des: Exceed 15.000 total weight of the town.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_CannedFoodie_Descr: Survive 30 consecutive days without cooking food.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_GullBoss_Descripti: Have more seagulls than drifters in your town.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_HappyGoLucky_Descr: Have 10 or more ecstatic drifters at the same time.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_HydroHomies_Descri: Use a total of 100 Fresh Water in a single day.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_ILoveMyJob_Descrip: Have 15 or more drifters doing their favorite task at the same time.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_LandHopper_Descrip: Fully salvage 15 different landmarks in one day.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_LoneWolf_Descripti: Survive 20 days with a single drifter.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_NoDrifterLeftBehin: Complete the game without having a drifter die.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_TheFinalChowdown_D: Craft 100 'Animal Chow' in a single day.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_TheFloatingRestaur: Cook 50 'Yummy' or higher quality food in a single day.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_TheJackOfAllTrades: Have a drifter with maximum expertise in all attributes.
ACHIEVEMENT_Challenge_TourDeMer_Descript: Generate over 150 Eels/s by only using Manual-Powered Generators.
ACHIEVEMENT_Quest_RadioStation_Descripti: Build a Radio Station to reach others!
ACHIEVEMENT_Quest_Tutorial_Title: How To Survive When Your World Has Flooded
Agent_Message_Scouting_Cache: Before I stranded on the island, I drifted past what seemed to be an abandoned settlement. Perhaps there are some useful resources there? I marked the location on the map.
Agent_Message_Scouting_Research: I used to live in this area before the flood. There should be a library nearby. I have marked the location the map.
Agent_Message_Scouting_Seagull: while I was searching for an island I saw a seagull in need of rescue! I have marked the location on the map.
Assignment_LandmarkInteraction_Descripti: Salvaging, interacting and scouting on landmarks.
Attribute_Athletics_Description: Determines how fast a drifter can run and swim.
Attribute_Construction_Description: Determines how fast a drifter can construct or deconstruct a building.
Attribute_Cooking_Description: Determines how fast a drifter can cook and prepare food.
Attribute_Crafting_Description: Determines how fast a drifter can craft things at workshops.
Attribute_Fishing_Description: Determines how fast a drifter can catch fish.
Attribute_Liquids_Description: Determines how fast a drifter can make liquid resources.
Attribute_Medicine_Description: A drifter proficient in medicine can cure drifters and craft medical supplies.
Attribute_Nautics_Tooltip:
Determines how fast a drifter can go by boat.

%ATTRIBUTE% Boat Speed
Attribute_Research_Description: Determines how fast a drifter can research new technologies.
Attribute_Salvaging_Description: Determines how fast drifters can collect items in the water and on landmarks.
BACKGROUND_Specialist_Aquaculturist_Desc: Created oil-eating fish to clean the ocean. Things got messy when they started infiltrating boats.
BACKGROUND_Specialist_Birdkeeper_Descrip: Turned noisy birds into a crafty salvage crew with nothing but minced fish and low-budget martial arts tapes.
BACKGROUND_Specialist_Chemist_Descriptio: When things go wrong, they don’t freak out. They bottle their emotions, and carry on.
BACKGROUND_Specialist_Electrician_Descri: They once powered an entire house with a kite, a fish, and a really well-timed lightning storm.
BUILDABLEACTION_CONTEXT_CHANGENAME_DESCR: Change the name of this building.
BUILDABLEACTION_CONTEXT_LINK_DESCRIPTION: Create an Eel-ectricity link by connecting this building to another.
BUILDABLEACTION_CONTEXT_SURVIVALGUIDE_DE: Open the Survival Guide page for this building.
BUILDABLEACTION_CONTEXT_TURNOFF_DESCRIPT: Turn this building OFF to disable its functionality and prevent drifters from using it.
BUILDABLEACTION_CONTEXT_TURNON_DESCRIPTI: Turn this building ON to enable its functionality and allow drifters to use it.
BUILDABLE_FishFarm_Hatchery_Description: Fish in the hatchery will spawn offspring every Brood cycle.
BUILDABLE_FishFarm_Nursery_Description: In the nursery, offspring will grow into adult fish over their Growth cycle.
BUILDABLE_FishFarm_Nursery_Empty: There are currently no fish of this type in the Nursery.
BUILDABLE_UPGRADE_AirFilter_Description: Reduces all inhabitants' pollution by {[AMOUNT]} whenever they sleep.
BUILDABLE_UPGRADE_MovementEnergyCost_Des: Reduces the town movement's energy cost by {[AMOUNT]}.
BUILDABLE_UPGRADE_MovementSpeed_Descript: Increases the town's movement speed by {[AMOUNT]}.
BUILDABLE_UPGRADE_Spaceship_Booster_Desc: Provides thrust for launching the spaceship.
BUILDABLE_UPGRADE_Spaceship_ColdStorage_: Keeps the fusion core safe at a low temperature.
BUILDABLE_UPGRADE_Spaceship_HeatShield_D: Protects the spaceship from extreme heat during re-entry.
BUILDABLE_UPGRADE_Spaceship_LifeSupport_: Maintains breathable air and suitable conditions for the crew.
BUILDABLE_WaterDistribution_Description: Use the 'Refill Threshold' slider to change when drifters should refill water up to the 'Refill Amount.'
Background_CookOfThePlasticSea_Descripti: %NAME% didn’t only survive the flood, it made sure it tasted all the riches of the new world! It’s favorite recipe: A quarter Flounder with cheese.
Background_LandHopper_Description: After the flood %NAME% spent his life hopping island after island with a tiny boat, scavenging for any remains in order to survive.
Background_Past_AthleticsCooking_Descrip: Shake milk, get swole, shake more milk. It's a vicious, delicious cycle.
Background_Past_AthleticsCrafting_Descri: Worked at a landfill, before those all got filled with water.
Background_Past_AthleticsDesalination_De: Eventually, fresh water became a more precious resource than oil. This drifter adapted accordingly.
Background_Past_AthleticsFishing_Descrip: In a stunning display of rage, this olympic angler dove into the water and put their prize fish into a headlock. Changed the sport overnight.
Background_Past_AthleticsNautics_Descrip: They joined a boat crew to find the edge of the world. The first floods didn't interrupt that plan, so they kept on sailing. They're still searching, to this day.
Background_Past_AthleticsResearch_Descri: Crash-landed a year after the first floods. Still doesn't quite understand what happened while they were gone.
Background_Past_AthleticsSalvaging_Descr: Infamously strong garbage custodian. Hurled trash bins with the force of a small explosion.
Background_Past_Athletics_Description: Held a championship title in both volleyball and water polo at the same time. Insisted the sports were, "Basically the same thing," to widespread anger and gnashing of teeth.
Background_Past_ConstructionAthletics_De: Building dams is all well and good, until the water comes from the other side and ruins the whole thing.
Background_Past_ConstructionCooking_Desc: Built a food truck with their bare hands and spare parts. Terrifying level of improvisation.
Background_Past_ConstructionCrafting_Des: Used to build model trains, and miniature cities for the trains to travel across. That's all gone, now.
Background_Past_ConstructionDesalination: Once the polar caps melted, it seemed a bit useless to chip ice into shapes. There's no ice left, for starters, which makes the job slightly more difficult.
Background_Past_ConstructionFishing_Desc: Used their experience operating cranes to win the best prizes in arcade claw games. Eventually banned.
Background_Past_ConstructionNautics_Desc: Lighthouses seemed less useful after the first flood. They stepped off of the top platform into a conveniently-placed boat, and never looked back.
Background_Past_ConstructionResearch_Des: Tried to stop the first floods. Failed.
Background_Past_ConstructionSalvaging_De: After the first floods washed away their home, they found shelter in any places they could.
Background_Past_Construction_Description: Did you know that you can make a house of cards that's seventy-eight stories tall? Yeah, they don't know either. Didn't stop them from trying, though.
Background_Past_CookingFishing_Descripti: Fished from drowned building gutters during the first floods. Also, gutted the fish.
Background_Past_CookingSalvaging_Descrip: Redefined the meaning of 'junk food' by making gourmet meals from discarded leftovers.
Background_Past_Cooking_Description: They believed crickets were the next big superfood before the first floods, and they would NOT shut up about it.
Background_Past_CraftingCooking_Descript: Award-winning creator of spaghetti bridges, meatball golems, and other culinary marvels.
Background_Past_CraftingFishing_Descript: You can make ladders for fish. You can even make tubes for fish! However, it takes a true visionary to transport fish safely via cannon.
Background_Past_CraftingResearch_Descrip: They were SO ready for the apocalypse... as long as it was zombie-related.
Background_Past_CraftingSalvaging_Descri: The type of person who would watch you drink a soda, so they could grab the empty can and turn it into a wind chime.
Background_Past_Crafting_Description: Recycling didn't fail - people did. They had an easy route to avoiding the first floods, and kept creating mountains of trash anyway. This drifter tries not to be resentful. They hold onto hope.
Background_Past_DesalinationCooking_Desc: Experienced brewer with discriminating tastes. Survived the first floods, because they didn't follow the MAIN STREAMS.
Background_Past_DesalinationCrafting_Des: Sometimes, they think about how much plastic crap they had to remove from pipes and plumbing. This all could have been avoided.
Background_Past_DesalinationFishing_Desc: Is there a more efficient method of fishing than draining a lake and collecting the fish from the bottom? No. No, there is not.
Background_Past_DesalinationResearch_Des: You want to know the difference between spring water, mountain water, fresh water, and water (with added electrolytes)? This is who you ask.
Background_Past_DesalinationSalvaging_De: Would drink practically anything for higher ratings - including their own urine. It was a different time.
Background_Past_Desalination_Description: There is nothing in this world more exciting than water - NOTHING. And this drifter knows it.
Background_Past_FishingSalvaging_Descrip: In a previous life, this fisher would catch nothing but boots, tires, and cans. They do the same thing now - but everyone loves it, all of a sudden. Weird.
Background_Past_Fishing_Description: Before the first floods, they fished for an entirely different, equally valuable resource: compliments.
Background_Past_NauticsCooking_Descripti: The first floods caught them on shore leave, and they swore to never again leave their boat. Makes fantastic smoothies. Despises everything non-bouyant.
Background_Past_NauticsCrafting_Descript: A former boatswain and current teller of exaggerated nautical tales.
Background_Past_NauticsDesalination_Desc: One night, while sailing through a lightning storm, a freak accident caused this drifter to fuse with the salt spray they spent a lifetime treading! They are in horrible pain, all of the time.
Background_Past_NauticsFishing_Descripti: They fished alone. They sailed alone. Loneliness became a habit.
Background_Past_NauticsResearch_Descript: Kept having to remove garbage from whale blowholes. Got so fed up that they invented a new, whale-friendly form of garbage.
Background_Past_NauticsSalvaging_Descrip: Used to crawling across ships, taking them apart to become something new.
Background_Past_Nautics_Description: In the most embarrassing boating accident ever recorded, this drifter managed to sail the world's largest cruise ship into the planet's last iceberg.
Background_Past_ResearchCooking_Descript: Their exacting eye for safety and innovation in the kitchen made them a treasure, and a scourge. Depends on who you ask.
Background_Past_ResearchFishing_Descript: Surprising knowledge of market trends and human psychology. Made video thumbnails, which taught them a thing or two about baiting.
Background_Past_ResearchSalvaging_Descri: Trapped in a sarcophagus during the first floods, they have intimate experience with the taste of mummy jerky. Sometimes, they miss it.
Background_Past_Research_Description: Agile on land and sea, growing up after the first floods gave them a fresh perspective on how to approach this new, watery world.
Background_Past_Salvaging_Description: Has extremely detailed opinions about metal detectors, and metal detecting accessories.
Background_PreFloodRenownedCaptain_Descr: In a former life, %NAME% was the Captain of the world’s largest ship. It sailed all over the world until it collided with the last Iceberg on the planet.
Background_PreFloodRuralLibrarian_Descri: Before the world washed all the books away, %NAME% was a librarian in a small, cozy little town.
Background_Present_AthleticsCooking_Desc: You can juice anything, this drifter insists. The disturbingly effective results they get seems to suggest that they have a point.
Background_Present_AthleticsCrafting_Des: Tried running on water using wooden shoes. It worked, but the wood was needed elsewhere.
Background_Present_AthleticsDesalination: Dancing between the rain is a useful skill, especially when the rain is made from thundering torrents of acidic pellets as a garbagestorm rages overhead.
Background_Present_AthleticsFishing_Desc: They crack open mussels with their bare hands, wrestling them open to feel something - anything.
Background_Present_AthleticsNautics_Desc: Occasionally, they'll disappear for a couple of weeks and come back with treasures from a distant land. You never know when. They never say where.
Background_Present_AthleticsResearch_Des: With a single breath, this drifter explores sunken ruins, skyscrapers, and other structures located next to reasonably convenient sources of air!
Background_Present_AthleticsSalvaging_De: In a flooded society, wreckage delvers are the closest thing we have to archivists. They preserve the world before, and you can get a piece for a small, suitable fee.
Background_Present_Athletics_Description: As silent as they are strong, this drifter lets their muscles speak for them.
Background_Present_ConstructionAthletics: You really think that some change in 'climate' could raise the sea level by 25 stories? WAKE UP! Aliens dumped sewage on our planet! The aristocracy are enjoying their sunken pleasure bunkers as we speak!!!
Background_Present_ConstructionCooking_D: The definition of someone playing with their food, they build houses out of pineapples, and drop them to the bottom of the sea. Unfortunate, but hopefully SOMETHING gets a use out of it.
Background_Present_ConstructionCrafting_: If the stories are true, this drifter can make a rope out of just about anything. Bark, seaweed, bottles... I heard they lashed together a boardwalk using human hair, once.
Background_Present_ConstructionDesalinat: Salt is easier to find than ever, but if you're looking for the GOOD STUFF, you need an expert. This is your expert.
Background_Present_ConstructionFishing_D: Is creating dynamite from spare chemicals and chucking it into the ocean efficient, or sane? Not really. It looks cool, though.
Background_Present_ConstructionNautics_D: They're a bit of a blowhard, but their knowledge of fluid dynamics and wind resistance makes them an invaluable part of a seafaring crew.
Background_Present_ConstructionResearch_: Collage-based art installations are a dozen times more ambitious, now that the resources of the entire WORLD are up for grabs. They dream of eventually getting their hands on a blimp.
Background_Present_ConstructionSalvaging: Every building is a mixtape, and this drifter can't wait to find the next groovy combination.
Background_Present_Construction_Descript: Where you see garbage, they see walls, infrastructure, and a new way of life. It's a pleasant perspective.
Background_Present_CookingFishing_Descri: With a new world, come new culinary riches. This drifter's favorite recipe is a quarter-flounder with cheese.
Background_Present_CookingSalvaging_Desc: Canning is more important than ever, after the floods. While many traditional methods are no longer possible (or useful), this drifter is at the forefront of preserved experimentation and cuisine.
Background_Present_Cooking_Description: They claimed to be a famous chef in the world before. We can't really disprove it, so why not play along?
Background_Present_CraftingCooking_Descr: Stranded on a small, inhospitable island in the early days of the flood, this drifter eventually found their way back to humanity. However, freedom came at a dire cost: the loss of their round, ball-shaped friend.
Background_Present_CraftingFishing_Descr: Even if we'll eat the fish later, making them comfortable with a nice woolen net crafted from strong, cushioned material just feels humane.
Background_Present_CraftingResearch_Desc: They crafted a diving bell from a plastic watch, three mussels, and 24 discarded restaurant straws. It allowed them to survive on the seafloor for literal weeks. They are my hero.
Background_Present_CraftingSalvaging_Des: They know what pile that hunk of plastic belongs to; what tower of cans this aluminum cylinder fits like a purpose-made glove... Their organization skills are inherent, and unmatched. Fear them.
Background_Present_Crafting_Description: You can build anything with scrap, if you're persistent enough. And weird. This drifter is both!
Background_Present_DesalinationCooking_D: One week in a toppled satellite dish OPENED THEIR MIND. From home-cooked recipes to interstellar signals, this drifter is filled with the knowledge of the cosmos - and every sitcom episode ever produced.
Background_Present_DesalinationCrafting_: Will get fresh water for their companions by any means necessary - including melting ice with their own precious body heat. Truly selfless.
Background_Present_DesalinationFishing_D: It's not quite dignified, but sucking the moisture from anemones and sea sponges was enough to get this drifter through several garbage storms.
